title: Kids' allowance and chores app
summary: Kids earn pocket money for chores via an app and card.
whyTempting: Parents want to teach money habits; it's a family-wide daily habit.
whyItFails: Banks copy it. Banks launch kids' accounts for free. Small revenue per family. Subscription fees are resisted. Kids age out. Customer lifetime is a few years.
whatWouldChange: Using it as an acquisition channel for a broader family financial product.

attempts.notes: Kids' debit card and money app in the UK and US.

reasons.detail: Banks copy it: Banks launch kids' accounts for free.
Small revenue per family: Subscription fees are resisted.
Kids age out: Customer lifetime is a few years.
